title: COMPUTER
content:
Hi The Fashion Shed 

Can you advise me what spec to get on a computer, my laptop is to recommendation for CLO but clearly it's not powerful enough. I want to get a tower computer. Also do you give private training. 

Thanks Vikki

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi @vikkijessop you can also find the CLO recommended specs on our websitehttps://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/0b6e5dfbff704c6199ffaa73ccb265ea

Comment 2: As long as it’s not slowing you down it’s all fine. I had a iMac before my PC and it was so slow!!! When your rendering catwalks and need to render 400 frames the difference between a 30 second render vs 2 mins makes a massive difference.
content_description: Provide expert computer specifications and private training recommendations to support optimal use of CLO software.

title: Sign In should not be this difficult!
content:
I can't believe I have to ask this question but how do you sign in to CLO 3D???!!! When I sign in it takes me to my account page. WHY???!!!! I had to keep changing my password because it said it wasn't correct. The only way I was able to get into Clo-Set is because I accepted the harder password that was auto-generated. But where is the main 2D/3D page for the software????!!!!!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi cdicker2, since you have signed up with an integrated account which is called CLO-SET, please try again with the 'sign in with CLO-SET' option. If you already tried, please share the screenshot where you saw the 'incorrect password' message.
content_description: This page provides guidance and troubleshooting tips for signing into CLO 3D and accessing its main 2D/3D workspace.

title: ColorPop Herringbone Collection
content:
**ColorPop Herringbone Collection**

**Timeless Texture, Vivid Expression**

The **ColorPop Herringbone Collection** blends the elegance of classic herringbone weave with modern, expressive colors. Crafted as double-sided fabrics with identical patterns on both sides, this series delivers a perfect balance of functionality and fashion. From calm neutrals to vibrant statement hues, each fabric adds a unique character to your designs—ideal for reversible outerwear, seasonal casuals, and standout lifestyle pieces.

* * *

**🧵 Fabric 1: CreamHerringbone DualTone**

**Soft Neutrals, Subtle Sophistication**

This refined cream tone is elevated by the texture of a double-sided herringbone weave. The result is a luxurious yet minimal fabric perfect for modern classic looks.

• **Material:** Premium Cotton-Polyester Blend

• **Weave:** Double-Sided Herringbone

• **Features:** Reversible, smooth touch, timeless tone

• **Recommended Uses:** Reversible outerwear, jackets, home textiles, classic casualwear

• **Rendering:** All rendering in CLO

• **PBR Maps:** ZFAB, TEXTURE, NORMAL MAP, ROUGHNESS MAP included

![bd0ce226dd58488db26130a0ca5bee1b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/380cd9d9e6874933a177fceb230b054f/images/bd0ce226dd58488db26130a0ca5bee1bBoth%20Side.jpg)

* * *

**🍑 Fabric 2: CoralHerringbone DualTone**

**Energetic Warmth, Bold Simplicity**

Featuring a rich coral hue, this fabric brings brightness and boldness to any creation. Its reversible herringbone structure offers both versatility and visual impact.

• **Material:** Premium Polyester-Cotton Blend

• **Weave:** Double-Sided Herringbone

• **Features:** Dual-side usability, vivid color, soft finish

• **Recommended Uses:** Reversible jackets, lifestyle apparel, statement pieces

• **Rendering:** All rendering in CLO

• **PBR Maps:** ZFAB, TEXTURE, NORMAL MAP, ROUGHNESS MAP included

![acd110a227274ad1b7104b085fd10544](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/380cd9d9e6874933a177fceb230b054f/images/acd110a227274ad1b7104b085fd10544Both%20Side_1.jpg)

* * *

**🍏 Fabric 3: LimeHerringbone DualTone**

**Vibrant Edge, Urban Cool**

A zesty lime green shade for those who dare to stand out. This dynamic tone, paired with a classic texture, is ideal for activewear and youth-forward fashion.

• **Material:** Premium Cotton-Polyester Blend

• **Weave:** Double-Sided Herringbone

• **Features:** Reversible texture, neon vibrancy, durable structure

• **Recommended Uses:** Streetwear, sportswear, limited-edition capsules

• **Rendering:** All rendering in CLO

• **PBR Maps:** ZFAB, TEXTURE, NORMAL MAP, ROUGHNESS MAP included

![d2a75434f9c94ed0adb9045c23434eb8](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/380cd9d9e6874933a177fceb230b054f/images/d2a75434f9c94ed0adb9045c23434eb8Both%20Side_2.jpg)

* * *

**💜 Fabric 4: VioletHerringbone DualTone**

**Subtle Depth, Artistic Flair**

A moody violet tone meets timeless herringbone detail. This fabric is perfect for gender-neutral fashion and poetic seasonal layering.

• **Material:** Premium Polyester-Cotton Blend

• **Weave:** Double-Sided Herringbone

• **Features:** Consistent dual-sided pattern, soft hand feel, long-lasting form

• **Recommended Uses:** Unisex fashion, poetic casualwear, outerwear layering

• **Rendering:** All rendering in CLO

• **PBR Maps:** ZFAB, TEXTURE, NORMAL MAP, ROUGHNESS MAP included

![6400e40386324971aed2f75975369098](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/380cd9d9e6874933a177fceb230b054f/images/6400e40386324971aed2f75975369098Both%20Side_3.jpg)
content_description: Showcasing the ColorPop Herringbone Collection’s vibrant, reversible double-sided fabrics that blend classic texture with modern color for versatile, stylish apparel and lifestyle designs.
